Description
Elemetal mint
is a precious metal company that is globally active. It is a new brand name for Ohio Precious Metals which has been one of the best precious metals manufacturers in the US for a long time.
Silver Rounds
such as the 1 oz Elemetal Silver Round are affordable and are a convenient way to include silver bullion in your investment portfolio.
Elemental Silver Round is made up of 1 troy ounce of .999 fine silver.
Elemental silver products are manufactured in refining facilities that are some of the best in the country. The refining facility where 1 oz elemental silver round is made is COMEX, LBMA, ISO 14001 and ISO 9001 certified. Because of this, the silver round meets the highest industry standards for product quality.
Design of 1 oz Elemetal Silver Round
Like any other elemetal mint product, the design of this elemetal bullion celebrates the science behind precious metals.
The reverse of the silver round includes the element silver. The reverse features the atomic structure of the Silver, the atomic number “47”, atomic mass “107.8682”, atomic symbol “Ag” and “Silver”. The inscription  SILVER and 1 TROY OUNCE.999 FINE can be seen on the reverse, which also depicts the distribution of electrons around the orbits of silver in concentric circles near the rim of the round.
The obverse of Elemetal Silver Round features the depiction of the elemetal’s logo along with the brand name. The phrase “Minted in The USA” is also inscribed on the obverse of the Elemetal Silver Round Coin which specifies that the Elemetal Silver Round was manufactured in the USA.
Main Highlights of 1 oz Elemetal Mint Silver Round
1 oz elemental silver rounds are great for investments. You can easily sell a 1 oz silver. Plus, Elemetal is a trusted brand whose products are very dependable.
Manufactured by Elemetal Mint.
Contains 1 troy oz of .999 fine silver
Approved for Precious Metal IRAs.
It comes with a plastic bag when you buy less than 20 rounds. If you buy 20 rounds, it will come in a tube.
Features the depiction of the Elemetal logo in the obverse.
Features the depiction of the atomic structure of silver in the reverse.
The design is informative and attractive.
